title: repro compare's frozen_pass passes a row that is good without the answer, so eval_passed rewards no answer
goal: bench_repro.frozen_pass passes a frozen row only when its answer is found, or when its end verdict ranks at least its start-commit verdict and is not good without the answer, so a false good row (good at start and end, answer not found) and a row none at start that turns good without the answer no longer pass and eval_passed, pick's first key, reads the answer gained (found by the SP-75hdeqld review as S2, carrying the change of BG-qztas5u4's gate g1)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bench_repro as b;r=(b.frozen_pass('good','good',False),b.frozen_pass('none','good',False));print(r);sys.exit(1 if any(r) else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bench_repro as b

# (start verdict, end verdict, answer found): whether the row passes
table = {('good', 'good', False): False, ('none', 'good', False): False, ('weak', 'good', False): False,
         ('good', 'weak', False): False, ('none', 'weak', False): True, ('none', 'none', False): True,
         ('weak', 'weak', False): True, ('none', 'good', True): True, ('good', 'good', True): True, ('weak', 'none', True): True}
got = {k: b.frozen_pass(*k) for k in table}
wrong = {k: v for k, v in got.items() if v != table[k]}
print('rows read wrong (start, end, found): passes', wrong)
sys.exit(0 if not wrong else 1)
